top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.

Road-specific control matters at Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 64 miles.
64 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Base fitness for Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca. Train it until it feels boring.
At Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca's mixed terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca's 64 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.altitude: Raul Alcala Challenge Oaxaca includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 64 miles of mixed terrain in Oaxaca de Juárez, Oaxaca, Mexico.
